leftEvidence.title: Jesus contrasts John’s water baptism with the Spirit promise

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The risen Jesus teaches about God’s Kingdom and tells the apostles to wait in Jerusalem for the Father’s promise.
points.right: Peter explains the Spirit’s coming on Gentiles by remembering the Lord’s contrast between John’s water baptism and baptism in the Holy Spirit.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: He recalls John’s water baptism and announces baptism in the Holy Spirit after a few days.
points.right: The Jerusalem hearers become quiet, glorify God, and recognize life-giving repentance among Gentiles.

payload.posture: Jesus announces Spirit baptism before the ascension, and Peter later identifies its fulfillment pattern in the Gentile Spirit event.

rightEvidence.title: Peter remembers Jesus’ words about John and the Spirit

payload.tension: The remembered saying connects events without making Jerusalem and Caesarea identical in every detail.
payload.title: The promise and Peter’s remembered application
